title: Detailed cherries
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="cherryGrad1" cx="40%" cy="35%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6688"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#e82040"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#b01030"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#801020"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="cherryGrad2" cx="45%" cy="35%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff5577"/>
      <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#d81838"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#a00c28"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#700818"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="highlight" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stems -->
  <path d="M46 52 Q42 36 50 24 Q56 16 62 12" fill="none" stroke="#5a9e30" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 50 Q60 38 56 28 Q54 22 50 24" fill="none" stroke="#4a8a28" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- stem join knot -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="22" rx="4" ry="3.5" fill="#6ab840"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="21" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#8ad860"/>

  <!-- leaf 1 -->
  <path d="M62 12 Q72 6 80 14 Q74 18 66 16 Z" fill="#4a9e28"/>
  <path d="M64 13 Q71 9 77 14" fill="none" stroke="#6ac040" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <path d="M62 12 Q58 8 54 10 Q56 14 62 14 Z" fill="#3a8a1e"/>

  <!-- leaf 2 -->
  <path d="M78 16 Q88 12 92 22 Q84 24 78 20 Z" fill="#52a830"/>
  <path d="M80 17 Q86 15 90 21" fill="none" stroke="#72c848" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- cherry 1 (left, larger) -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="60" r="19" fill="url(#cherryGrad1)"/>
  <!-- cherry 1 inner shading ring -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="60" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#c01630" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- cherry 1 highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="53" rx="7" ry="5" fill="url(#highlight)" transform="rotate(-25 34 53)"/>
  <!-- cherry 1 secondary highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="52" rx="3.5" ry="2.2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9" transform="rotate(-25 36 52)"/>
  <!-- cherry 1 top dimple -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="43" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#901828" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- cherry 2 (right, slightly smaller) -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="64" r="17" fill="url(#cherryGrad2)"/>
  <!-- cherry 2 inner shading ring -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="64" r="14" fill="none" stroke="#b0122c" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- cherry 2 highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="58" rx="6" ry="4.5" fill="url(#highlight)" transform="rotate(-25 57 58)"/>
  <!-- cherry 2 secondary highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="59" cy="57" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9" transform="rotate(-25 59 57)"/>
  <!-- cherry 2 top dimple -->
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="48" rx="2.8" ry="1.8" fill="#881424" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- subtle glow reflections near stems -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="52" r="2" fill="#ff8899" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#ff8899" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
